page_title: ATM 1-1 ELC | Atletico Madrid v Elche 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
90+5' Referee Cesar Soto Grado has finally had enough of Diego Simeone and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
90+3' Half-chance! Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Matias Dituro reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee gives a yellow card to Matias Dituro (Elche).
89' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Matias Dituro.
88' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).

87' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Elche, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
85' Here is a change. Marc Aguado is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Federico Redondo Solari (Elche).
83' Handball by Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid). It's a free kick to Elche in a dangerous position.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedro Bigas leaves the pitch and Leo Petrot (Elche) comes on.

81' Golden chance! Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
80' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
75' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Matteo Ruggeri and he is replaced by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
75' Substitution. Giuliano Simeone makes his way off the pitch and Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
75' It looks like Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Cesar Soto Grado won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Elche.
72' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid). There is a free kick near the sideline to Elche.

72' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Matias Dituro pulls off an easy save.
71' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
70' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
70' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.
70' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but Matias Dituro punches the ball away. Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
68' Here comes a substitution. Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Alexander Sorloth.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) replaces Thiago Almada.
68' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Johnny Cardoso will be replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
68' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martim Neto (Elche) replacing Rodrigo Mendoza.
67' The attendance is 59369.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Andre Silva (Elche) is replacing Rafa Mir.
63' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matias Dituro, who smothers the ball.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
63' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Atl. Madrid get a corner.
61' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
61' Elche concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Atl. Madrid have a free kick.

60' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Matias Dituro shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
59' Wow, what an escape. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
58' Half-chance! Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Matias Dituro reacts well to snuff out the attack.
57' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
55' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. Elche win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
55' Aleix Febas (Elche) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
54' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
52' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Elche, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Elche.
47' A quickly taken corner by Elche.
47' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Elche.
46' Eder Sarabia has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Victor Chust (Elche) comes on the pitch for John Donald.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+7' The free kick into the box finds Pedro Bigas (Elche), who directs his header into the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping.
45+6' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Elche get a free kick.
45+6' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+5' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) sees a yellow card from Cesar Soto Grado after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
44' David Affengruber (Elche) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
42' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
40' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the left post.
40' A corner kick by Atl. Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Matias Dituro (Elche).
39' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Atl. Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
38' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Matias Dituro comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.
38' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Atl. Madrid win a corner.
37' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
37' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
34' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Elche will take a free kick near the side line.
33' A cross from a corner kick by Atl. Madrid is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
30' The referee blows for a cooling break.
29' Aleix Febas (Elche) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Cesar Soto Grado didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

27' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
24' Rafa Mir (Elche) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
22' The game is interrupted now, Rafa Mir (Elche) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' Dangerous play by Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. Elche earn a free kick.
21' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid). Elche are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
19' A lofted cross from German Valera (Elche) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
18' The corner from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
17' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
15' 1 - 1 Goal! Alvaro Rodriguez provides Rafa Mir (Elche) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
15' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

14' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Matias Dituro to get hold of the ball. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
13' Rafa Mir (Elche) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
11' Chance! Rafa Mir (Elche) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

8' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from David Hancko inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.

7' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
7' German Valera (Elche) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
6' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matias Dituro intercepts the ball.
4' The referee blows his whistle as Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge. Elche are awarded the free kick.
3' A pass by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
2' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
2' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
1' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game. One of the players from Elche won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Elche will kick the game off.
